profile.headline: Team Lead Senior Software Engineer  @ General Motors | Cloud-Native Microservices
profile.summary:
Seasoned Software Engineering Leader with over 25 years of experience architecting and delivering scalable, mission-critical systems across the automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, and e-commerce industries. My career is defined by driving technical strategy and leading full-cycle software development, from system architecture and infrastructure migration to rigorous compliance and high-availability production support.

Currently, I lead the Digital Sales Development team at General Motors, defining the technical vision to modernize monolithic legacy systems into resilient, cloud-native microservice ecosystems. Recently, I architected and delivered core microservices (sales-product-autoassign) that streamline and enable complex trial offer qualification. By spearheading the integration of highly scalable, rule-based automation using Drools on a robust Spring Boot and Azure stack, I have driven significant efficiencies across GM's Digital Sales Offer platform.

As a technical leader, my goal is to act as a "force multiplier." My leadership extends beyond architecture to actively mentoring cross-functional engineering teams through hands-on training programs, proof-of-concepts, and best-practice implementation. I am deeply motivated by solving complex system challenges, enhancing technical ownership, and delivering high-performance platforms that power next-generation customer experiences.

I am committed to building innovative, resilient solutions that aggressively drive scale and digital transformation for next-generation technology platforms.

Core Expertise & Technologies: 
• Technical Expertise: Cloud-Native Architecture, Enterprise Integration Frameworks, Microservices Migration, AI-Accelerated Development, System Resiliency, Rule-Based Automation 
• Tech Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Azure, PCF, Drools, React/TypeScript, LLMs, Agentic Tools (n8n, Cursor, Copilot)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead - Digital Sales Development Team
positions.description:
•    Platform Modernization: Defined technical vision and drove the multi-year migration of GM’s legacy Digital Sales Offer monolithic systems into a resilient, cloud-native microservices ecosystem.
•    High-Performance Architecture: Architected a high-concurrency Java CompletableFuture framework to parallelize cross-domain API integrations. Sustained peak sales event throughput, reducing latency by 75%.
•    Global Enterprise Rule Engine: Spearheaded a highly scalable, Drools-based Rule Qualification Framework, decoupling complex business logic from core services. Currently guiding the strategic architectural expansion of this microservices ecosystem from GMNA to GMSA and the broader GM Global Region.
•    Resiliency, Observability & PRR: Established a "Zero-Failure" integration standard by executing Phase 4 of GM’s Production Readiness Review (PRR). Instituted best practices via Resilience4j circuit breakers and Datadog monitoring (SLIs/SLOs). Achieved 99.9% availability and reduced MTTR by 50%. This framework now serves as the active reference architecture for other microservice teams.
•    Force Multiplication & AI Development: Leveraged advanced AI and agentic workflows to rapidly architect a React/TypeScript diagnostic platform that slashed Drools troubleshooting time from hours to minutes. Engineered an interactive telemetry interface with recursive variable expansion to instantly trace failures across 1,000+ nested rules, and implemented automated compliance scanning to proactively block production misconfigurations.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead - In Salesforce CRM Back-End Development
positions.description:
•    Cross-Functional Leadership: Led a cross-functional team in building and scaling CRM microservices, delivering five high-availability integrations between GM’s GAA platform and Salesforce.
•    Force Multiplication & Mentorship: Designed and facilitated a six-week microservices bootcamp, training 12 engineers in Spring Boot, Docker, and event-driven architecture best practices.
•    Data Consistency Architecture: Architected and implemented synchronization services (adv-ocrmsync-gaatoocrm and adv-ocrmsync-ocrmtogaa) to ensure near-real-time data consistency (≤ 2-minute latency) for vehicle, marketing, and emergency contact records.
•    Event-Driven Integrations: Developed adv-ocrmbff-liec, a microservice leveraging CometD to ingest Lost Inbound Emergency Calls from Genesys CTI, resulting in a 40% improvement in SLA adherence for customer support tickets.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead- In GAA
positions.description:
•	Led the GAA TechRefresh initiative, migrating 600+ WebLogic servers to Linux, reducing infrastructure costs by 20% and increasing platform uptime to 99.98%.
•	Implemented multi-factor authentication (MFA) for Stolen Vehicle Assistance (SVA), achieving PCI compliance ahead of schedule and strengthening platform security.
•	Orchestrated the upgrade of WebLogic from 12.1.3 to 12.2.1.4, coordinating cross-team testing for 50+ dependent applications.
•	Architected and delivered multiple Spring Boot microservices on Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF), including:
o	veh-numberprovision: automated vehicle onboarding
o	lbs-activitydetail: enabled detailed location-based tracking
o	cust-interaction-history: provided comprehensive customer interaction logs

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description:
•	Led the JCAPS Integration Team in analyzing and migrating GME real-time and batch interfaces to IBM Integration Bus (IIB).
•	Directed end-to-end migration strategy, reducing support overhead and improving system reliability.
•	Provided technical leadership and mentorship across the GIF Integration Team, fostering growth and best practices in integration development.

positions.title: Sr. EAI / SOA Architect
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded one of the largest EAI/SOA implementations in the manufacturing industry, integrating over 1,000 interfaces supporting real-time and batch transactions.
•	Integrated more than 200 interfaces with QAD/QXtend ERP systems using web services and batch processing.
•	Designed and implemented Visteon's EAI Common Frameworks, including:
o	MFT (Managed File Transfer): Supporting FTP, FTPS, and SFTP protocols
o	Common Web Service Server/Client: With HTTP/HTTPS support
o	CRS (Common Routing Service), CMSF (Common Message Service Framework)
o	Common Scheduler, Email Approval Framework
•	Developed a custom PGP Encryption/Decryption utility based on OpenPGP standards.
•	Created the Java Type Definition (JTD) API for automatic message parsing and transformation between delimited and fixed formats.
•	Delivered training, demos, and ongoing mentoring on JCAPS to internal EAI team members, enhancing team competency and solution quality.
positions.insights: Skills: JCAPS · EAI Integration · Spring MVC · Oracle Database · J2EE Web Services · Java · Core Java · Spring Framework

positions.title: Sr. JCAPS Developers
positions.description:
★ Designed and developed JCAPS interfaces for Metavance 2.6B and 2.7B Version. 
★ Designed a standardized messaging format called the Service Interface in CRS(Common Routing Service) Framework. 
★ Designed and developed CRS(Common Routing Service) Framework which is a standardized messaging framework for delivering request / response patterned messaging within the A3 Back Plane.
★ Developed Standard Downstream Service Framework to serve as a guide for developers implementing Common Routing Framework based services within JCAPS. 
★ Developed Log and Exception Handlers with CSF(Common Service Framework) and configured / tested CSF for HEAT / ATG (Auto Ticket Generator)
★ Developed Testing Harness Tools (HTTP and JMS) to simulate front-end application.  
★ Supported DIT Environment Migration for CSF, CRS, a few Interfaces, and Test Harness Tools. 
★ Conducted demos, training sessions and overall SeeBeyond mentoring to ESP team members.
positions.insights: Skills: EAI Integration · Oracle Database · J2EE Web Services · Java · Core Java

positions.description:
★ Helped Customer EAI Projects in the levels of  Architecture and Implementation as a SeeBeyond Architect

★ Trained SeeBeyond Customer and Partners with SeeBeyond Products.
